item.description:
A slower rain, a window of your own

  • Hundreds of small beads cling to the glass. Occasional heavy drops merge and glide down slowly.
  • Focused glass, inverted reflections, dark upper edges and fine lower highlights. Use Focus to soften the street behind it.
  • Subtle rain outside the window changes its placement and depth on every descent.
  • Four new Istanbul photographs: a rainy night at Galata Bridge, Ayasofya in rain, a quiet wet courtyard, and a grey day on the Bosphorus.
  • Weather matching now excludes sunny photographs from rain and keeps snowy photographs for snow.
  • Check for Updates from the menu bar, download the signed GitHub release, and install and relaunch inside Sokak. Optional automatic checks; installation stays your choice.

macOS 13 or later. Settings and personal photographs are preserved. This community build is ad-hoc signed and is not Apple-notarized; your Mac's normal installation policy still applies.
